Policy

Certification and independence policy

An academy can map to a framework without being accredited, and a credential can exist without being equivalent to another. This page says precisely what we claim and what we do not.

Our independence policy

  • Intellica owns its curriculum, teaching, practice items, labs, credential names, rules and decisions. Public frameworks and exam blueprints are references and mappings only.
  • Intellica is independent of GIAC, ISC2, ISACA, CompTIA, CSA, IAPP, OWASP, MITRE and NIST. Nothing here suggests an affiliation, approval or partnership.
  • We use no protected exam questions, leaked questions, confidential task briefs, logos or marketing claims from any other organisation.
  • A mapping shows which of our lessons relate to a published objective. It does not mean a level replaces, counts towards or predicts the result of any external exam, and it does not satisfy any experience requirement.
  • External exam orientation and Intellica assessment stay separate. The first familiarises you with public objectives and exam mechanics. The second measures Intellica’s own published competence standard.
  • No Intellica credential has been issued yet. When the scheme launches, the handbook, candidate rules, appeals process and renewal policy will be published first.

The six planned credentials

Working titles. None has been issued.

LevelWorking credential titleCapstone evidence
Level 1Agentic Cybersecurity FoundationsFoundational knowledge exam, a safe lab practical and a basic threat model of a small agent.
Level 2Agentic Application Security ProfessionalA secure-agent application project with abuse cases, a verification report and a code and configuration review.
Level 3Agentic Security ArchitectArchitecture dossier: threat model, security requirements, control matrix, failure-mode analysis, deployment baseline and a live architecture defence.
Level 4Agentic Security Operations ProfessionalA live incident simulation with injects, time-boxed decisions, evidence handling and a post-incident report.
Level 5Agentic Red Teaming and Assurance ProfessionalA scoped red-team engagement against a purpose-built target, with an evidence pack, reproducible tests and a remediation retest.
Level 6Principal Agentic Security and Governance ProfessionalAn enterprise agentic security programme with policy and control architecture, a risk and impact assessment, a supplier assurance pack, a board paper and an independent oral defence.

How a level is earned

Knowledge is necessary, not sufficient

Every level combines blueprint-balanced knowledge items with observed lab or design work. A knowledge score alone never earns a level.

Evidence you can inspect

Each lesson ends in an artefact that goes into one evolving portfolio, the Secure Agentic Enterprise Dossier, so assessors review what you built.

Controls must fail closed

Practical tasks include negative tests: the control has to refuse the attack, not just permit the intended use.

Unseen forms and item control

Practice items and assessment items are separate pools. Assessment items are exposure-tracked and retired.

Separated decisions

The people who teach a level do not decide whether a candidate meets the standard. Appeals go to a reviewer who did not assess the candidate.

Design benchmark, not a claim

ISO/IEC 17024:2026 guides the design of the scheme. Intellica makes no accreditation or conformity claim.

Reading the market precisely

Different things get called accreditation. We keep them apart.

KindWhat it meansHow we use it
Professional certificationA body certifies that an individual met its own exam, experience and renewal requirements.Map public domains. Never claim equivalence or award another body’s credential.
Accredited personnel certificationAn independent accreditation body assesses a certification body against a standard such as ISO/IEC 17024.A long-term design benchmark for our own scheme. We make no accreditation claim.
Management-system certificationAn organisation’s management system is certified, for example to ISO/IEC 27001 or 42001.We teach implementation and audit readiness. A learner credential does not certify an organisation.
Framework or standardA control set, taxonomy or reference architecture.Source material and assessment criteria. It is not a personal certification.
Course alignmentA provider maps lessons to public objectives.We publish the mapping with this disclaimer.

What you get today

The live course already issues a completion certificate. It is a record based on your own reported progress, not an Intellica academy credential. See the course page for exactly what it attests.
